_about: Defaults for shared/local-pages 0.3. Read by scripts/local_gate.py and scripts/demand.py (and, through the copy the BYM site vendors, by its CI and the BYM Team connector). A site can override any value with its own JSON passed as --config. 0.3 (2026-11-11, Mike approved the 'Will it rank?' standard): client service x city pages (buyer-page) are lean and built to rank only after shared/rank-check Check 1 passes; BYM industry x city pages (owner-report) are sales assets, never ranking pages. Evidence: seo-system/research/08-what-ranks.md 4.1-4.2, 09-serp-teardown.md 3.8, 5, 6(c), 10-coach-panel.md.
_awaiting_mike: lean.padding: over 1.6x the top-3 median word count (or median + 300) fails; over 1.25x warns
lean.local_proof_min_kinds: 2 of office or address, named staff, reviews from the city, job photos
check1.fresh_days: a Check 1 record older than 90 days is run again
owner-report sales assets ship indexable (not noindex), outside the ranking queue (bym-local-service-pages)
profiles.buyer-page.existing_pages: Legacy Linen's 30 city x service pages, fold into 5 city hubs or keep

buyer-page._about: The ranking program: a consumer business's service x city page (reader buys the service). Lean anatomy, Check 1 first, profile-first plan. Competitors are never named; the map read is internal.

owner-report._about: BYM industry x city market report for the owner of a company in the trade: a sales or outreach asset sent to a named prospect or campaign, never targeted for ranking or reported on rank. Keeps the fixed skeleton below.

check1._about: Check 1 is shared/rank-check's 'should this page exist' gate (shared/rank-check/references/). local-pages only checks that its record is there, passes and is fresh, plus the local reading of two of its checks. If rank-check renames a check, add the new name under aliases; rank-check's thresholds win over the two under local.

lean._about: buyer-page anatomy (references/anatomy.md): one page per service and city, service + city in the title, H1 and URL, phone and quote on the first phone screen, what the top 3 cover, local proof, FAQ only from real SERP questions, length from the top 3's median.

profile_first._about: Every buyer-page build ships with its profile plan: bym/gbp-ops gets the website link to this page for the city, the primary category and the review plan; shared/citation-building gets the link and citation tasks.

_skeleton_about: owner-report only (anatomy 'skeleton'): the fixed section order and H2 patterns of a BYM market report.

skeleton.pattern: The {city} map today|{service} in {city}: what we see|What we see in {city}
Price and how it works|How it works
Questions from {city}.*|Questions {service} owners ask us|Questions .+ ask us

_modules_about: Data modules are optional since 0.3: include one only where it adds what the top 10 lack (rank-check L7), never to reach a count. Below an included module's honesty minimums it is dropped, never padded.

floor._about: Advisory since 0.3 (a warning, owner-report only): the market report's expected depth, not a ranking rule.

similarity._about: 5-word shingle Jaccard of prose (fixed blocks and headings excluded), with each page's own city name neutralised so a city swap can't hide a copy.

build_rules._about: G7. buyer-page: a passing Check 1 record first. owner-report: a named sales target. Both: the doorway rules (too close, same market, no live hub, not served, paused).
